title: Museum Four Digit Explorer
focus: Align thousands, hundreds, tens and ones to add four-digit numbers without regrouping.

quiz.context: At a museum learning event in Kuala Lumpur, Aina has 1523 visitor stickers and receives 2234 more. How many visitor stickers does Aina have altogether?
At a museum learning event in Kuala Lumpur, Wei Jie has 3142 visitor stickers and receives 1625 more. How many visitor stickers does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a museum learning event in Kuala Lumpur, Arun has 4213 visitor stickers and receives 2574 more. How many visitor stickers does Arun have altogether?

title: City Lights Regrouping Run
focus: Regroup in consecutive columns when adding four-digit numbers with totals below 10000.

quiz.context: At a lantern craft event in Penang, Aina has 1578 paper shapes and receives 2267 more. How many paper shapes does Aina have altogether?
At a lantern craft event in Penang, Wei Jie has 2689 paper shapes and receives 3156 more. How many paper shapes does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a lantern craft event in Penang, Arun has 3768 paper shapes and receives 2179 more. How many paper shapes does Arun have altogether?

title: Friendly Number Forest Route
focus: Round a number close to a whole thousand up, add, then subtract the small adjustment.

title: Double Treasure Delivery

title: Heritage Trail Place Values

title: Three Zeroes Bridge Rescue

title: Near Thousands Detective

title: School Supply Balance Quest

title: Rainforest Packs Six and Eight
